title: idpd authenticate
description: The IDP-Dienst's Authenticator-Modul flow run for an authorization URL with an identity: the authorization code the relying party exchanges, and what the exchange rested on.

schema.description: The JSON contract version; fields are only added within it.

code.description: The authorization code (itself a JWE of the IDP's)

state.description: The relying party's state, echoed by the IDP

redirect_url.description: The Location the IDP answered with

challenge.description: Claims of the IDP's challenge: who asked and for what

warnings.description: What was not proven: the IDP's certificates are not yet checked against the TSL
